TestCDCTraceInfo::test_tracing_update_na.description: Single-node cluster, table (pkey int, ckey int, value text) WITH cdc enabled (preimage+postimage). Runs `TRACING ON;` + single UPDATE via cqlsh and parses the trace: asserts 'CDC: Started generating...' first, 'Finished generating all log mutations' last, and per affected partition token, in order: Selecting preimage, 'Generating log mutations', No need to split, 'Generated N log mutations'; no unmatched CDC lines. Guards CDC tracing instrumentation and the should_split / preimage-select decision for this operation.
